title: Smallest Sufficient Team
description: Find the smallest subset of people whose skills cover all required skills.
pseudocode:
1. n = req_skills.length, m = people.length
2. skill_map = map(skill: bit_index)
3. dp = {0: []}
4. for i from 0 to m-1:
5.   person_mask = get_mask(people[i])
6.   for mask, team in dp:
7.     new_mask = mask | person_mask
8.     if new_mask not in dp or dp[new_mask].len > team.len + 1:
9.       dp[new_mask] = team + [i]

steps.note: Map skills to bit indices: Java:0, NodeJS:1, ReactJS:2
Update dp: mask 3 is now covered by team [0]
Combine person 1 with existing mask 3, new mask 7 (binary 111)
